info.name: Microsoft Graph Admin Admin.admin Applications Restore API

items.docs:
Restore a recently deleted application, group, servicePrincipal, administrative unit, or user object from deleted items.  Restore a recently deleted directory object from deleted items. The following types are supported:
- administrativeUnit
- application
- certificateBasedAuthPki
- certificateAuthorityDetail
- group
- servicePrincipal
- user If an item is accidentally deleted, you can fully restore the item. Additionally, restoring an application doesn't automatically restore the associa
